newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HARDCORE PORN SALES TO DRY UP AT DUTCH SHELL PUMPS.
newsitem.headline: HARDCORE PORN SALES TO DRY UP AT DUTCH SHELL PUMPS.

text.p: Oil giant Shell said it will stop sales of hardcore pornographic magazines and videos at its Dutch service stations, as part of the company's strategy of diversifying into food sales.
The new guideline comes into force on Saturday.

"We have received complaints from customers and we have decided to introduce a new shop concept.... We expect more women, children and elderly customers and these groups would probably feel annoyed at this kind of material," said a Shell spokesman.
The decisions means Shell stations will no longer stock such titles as Binky, Ami, Kick and Chick.
But devotees will however still be able to buy the "softer" erotic magazines Penthouse and Playboy.
"We feel these magazines are in general terms accepted in society," the Shell spokesman said.
